items: Article 275 deals with Statutory Grants recommended by the Finance Commission, whereas Article 282 deals with Discretionary Grants.
Statutory grants under Article 275 are charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India and are not subject to annual voting by Parliament.
Grants for promoting the welfare of Scheduled Tribes are mandatory statutory grants under the proviso to Article 275(1).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Statutory grants are provided under Article 275 of the Constitution based on recommendations of the Finance Commission.
Discretionary grants under Article 282 empower the Union and States to make grants for any public purpose.
Statutory grants are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India and differ in allocation for different states.
Special grants under Article 275(1) target the welfare of Scheduled Tribes and raising administration levels in Scheduled Areas.
